scoring_justification: T1 recompute is infeasible because the CSV contract lacks a parent‑temperature column; T3 structural audit checks spatial correlation and the universal box‑size dependence of the standard deviation.

schema.description: Per-box per-snapshot local shear (five components) and bulk moduli, with parent temperature.

outputs.description: Raw local moduli per coarse-graining box and snapshot for all parent temperatures and box sizes. The checker will group by Tp and box size, compute standard deviations of the local moduli and nearest-neighbor correlation parameters, and verify monotonic trends and low correlation.

output_contract.notes: The scorer performs a structural audit: standard deviation of local moduli should decrease with decreasing parent temperature, and nearest-neighbor correlation parameters should be small (|Ψ| < 0.1).

steps.description: Validate spatial correlation (|Ψ| < 0.1) and monotonic decrease of standard deviation with box size (larger w ⇒ smaller std) for shear and bulk moduli.
